creators.name: xAI (SpaceXSI)
creators.role: AI company behind Grok; its 2026 pages carry the SpaceXSI name
creators.bio: xAI develops the Grok models and the Grok Voice speech-to-speech and transcription APIs.
creators.why: Grok Voice runs at scale in Tesla cars and Starlink support lines, a rare public account of voice agents in daily use.
creators.role_zh: Grok 背后的 AI 公司；其 2026 年的页面使用 SpaceXSI 名称
creators.bio_zh: xAI 开发 Grok 系列模型，以及 Grok Voice 语音到语音与语音转写 API。
creators.why_zh: Grok Voice 已大规模用于特斯拉汽车和 Starlink 客服热线，是语音智能体日常使用情况少有的公开记录。

creators.name: Mirelo
creators.role: Audio AI company making video-to-sound models
creators.bio: Mirelo builds generative models that add sound effects, foley and ambience to video, offered through a studio, an API and editor plugins.
creators.why: It treats the sound of generated video as a separate model layer that can be replaced without regenerating the picture.
creators.role_zh: 制作视频生成音效模型的音频 AI 公司
creators.bio_zh: Mirelo 开发为视频添加音效、拟音与环境声的生成模型，通过在线工作室、API 和剪辑软件插件提供。
creators.why_zh: 它把生成视频的声音当作独立的模型层，无需重新生成画面就能替换。

creators.name: Fish Audio
creators.bio: Fish Audio runs a text-to-speech and voice-cloning platform and publishes open-weight TTS models, from Fish Speech to Drama 3.
creators.why: Its open multi-speaker models let a lab run expressive character voices on its own hardware and pin a version.
creators.role_zh: 语音 AI 公司（Hanabi AI Inc.）
creators.bio_zh: Fish Audio 运营语音合成与声音克隆平台，并发布开源权重的语音合成模型，从 Fish Speech 到 Drama 3。
creators.why_zh: 它的开源多说话人模型让实验室可以在自己的硬件上运行富有表现力的角色声音，并固定使用某一版本。

creators.name: Duowen Chen
creators.bio: Duowen Chen works on simulation and sound for generated 3D worlds in Bo Zhu's group at the Georgia Institute of Technology.
creators.why: First author of Audible World Models, which anchors generated sounds to the geometry of generated 3D worlds.
creators.role_zh: 仿真与图形学研究者（佐治亚理工学院）
creators.bio_zh: Duowen Chen 在佐治亚理工学院 Bo Zhu 课题组研究生成式三维世界中的仿真与声音。
creators.why_zh: Audible World Models 的第一作者，该方法把生成的声音锚定在生成三维世界的几何结构上。

creators.name: Pengjun Fang
creators.role: Audio generation researcher (HKUST and Noiz AI)
creators.bio: Pengjun Fang works on video-to-audio generation at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology and the start-up Noiz AI.
creators.why: First author of WorldSonus, a streaming video-to-stereo-audio model built for interactive world models.
creators.role_zh: 音频生成研究者（香港科技大学与 Noiz AI）
creators.bio_zh: Pengjun Fang 在香港科技大学和初创公司 Noiz AI 研究视频到音频的生成。
creators.why_zh: WorldSonus 的第一作者，这是一个为交互式世界模型设计的流式视频生成立体声模型。

creators.name: Zitong Lan
creators.role: Acoustics and spatial audio researcher (University of Pennsylvania)
creators.bio: Zitong Lan works on acoustic simulation and spatial audio in Mingmin Zhao's group at the University of Pennsylvania.
creators.why: First author of OmniDream, which turns a silent video into a 360° scene with spatially aligned sound.
creators.role_zh: 声学与空间音频研究者（宾夕法尼亚大学）
creators.bio_zh: Zitong Lan 在宾夕法尼亚大学 Mingmin Zhao 课题组研究声学仿真与空间音频。
creators.why_zh: OmniDream 的第一作者，该方法把无声视频变成声音与画面空间对齐的 360° 场景。

creators.name: Hanmo Chen
creators.role: Video-audio generation researcher (Xidian University and vivo BlueImage Lab)
creators.bio: Hanmo Chen works on joint video-audio generation at Xidian University and vivo's BlueImage Lab.
creators.why: First author of StereoBind, which makes the stereo position of generated sound follow its moving source on screen.
creators.role_zh: 音视频联合生成研究者（西安电子科技大学与 vivo 蓝图影像实验室）
creators.bio_zh: Hanmo Chen 在西安电子科技大学和 vivo 蓝图影像实验室研究音视频联合生成。
creators.why_zh: StereoBind 的第一作者，该方法让生成声音的立体声位置跟随画面中移动的声源。

creators.name: Ryu Furusawa
creators.bio: Ryu Furusawa is a Japanese video artist who restructures recorded footage in time and space.
creators.why: His installation Passing drives a real-time video-to-audio model from a live, viewer-responsive video stream.
creators.bio_zh: Ryu Furusawa 是日本影像艺术家，擅长在时间与空间上重组拍摄的影像。
creators.why_zh: 他的装置作品 Passing 用一段随观众在场而变化的实时影像流来驱动实时视频生成音频模型。

creators.name: Gradium
creators.role: Voice AI company founded by Kyutai's Moshi researchers
creators.bio: Gradium sells streaming speech synthesis, recognition, translation and voice design for voice agents; it raised a $100M seed by July 2026.
creators.why: It shows the authors of the first open full-duplex model turning to production voice infrastructure.
creators.role_zh: 由 Kyutai 的 Moshi 研究者创立的语音 AI 公司
creators.bio_zh: Gradium 为语音智能体提供流式语音合成、语音识别、翻译与声音设计；到 2026 年 7 月其种子轮融资达到 1 亿美元。
creators.why_zh: 它表明第一个开源全双工模型的作者们转向了面向生产的语音基础设施。

creators.name: Sony Group
creators.role: Electronics and entertainment group (Sony AI, Creative AI Lab)
creators.bio: Sony's Creative AI Lab researches generative audio, including sound-effect and video-to-audio models such as SpecMaskFoley.
creators.why: It brings audio generation research into artworks and production tools.
creators.role_zh: 电子与娱乐集团（Sony AI、Creative AI Lab）
creators.bio_zh: 索尼的 Creative AI Lab 研究生成式音频，包括音效生成和 SpecMaskFoley 等视频生成音频模型。
creators.why_zh: 它把音频生成研究带进艺术作品和制作工具。

works.title: Realtime TTS-2
works.description: Inworld's text-to-speech model for live conversation: it hears the audio of the previous turns, so the same line sounds softer after bad news and brighter after a joke, and it takes stage directions in plain English such as [speak tired but warm]. Launched on 5 May 2026 and generally available since 31 August 2026; Inworld's Realtime API wraps it in a speech-to-speech session that is marketed as full-duplex but waits for the end of the user's turn and stops when interrupted.
works.description_zh: Inworld 面向实时对话的语音合成模型：它能听到前几轮对话的音频，因此同一句话在坏消息之后会更柔和，在玩笑之后会更明快；它还接受用日常英语写的表演指示，例如 [speak tired but warm]。2026 年 5 月 5 日发布，8 月 31 日起正式可用；Inworld 的 Realtime API 把它封装成语音到语音会话，宣传为全双工，但实际上要等用户说完才回应，被打断时停止说话。
works.idea_en: Delivery conditioned on how the person actually sounded gives a scripted character an affective reaction without hand-tagging every line.
works.idea_zh: 根据对方实际的说话语气来调整发声，让脚本化的角色无需逐句标注也能有情绪上的回应。
works.method: TTS model that takes prior-turn audio as context, with natural-language steering tags and prose voice design; a Flash variant (9 August 2026) drops steering for lower latency.
works.method_zh: 以前几轮对话音频为上下文的语音合成模型，支持自然语言表演指示标签和用文字描述设计声音；2026 年 8 月 9 日推出的 Flash 版本去掉表演指示以换取更低延迟。
works.specs: TTS-2 ~100 ms · TTS-2 Flash 20 ms time to first audio (server-side P90, developer claim) · 100+ languages

works.title: Grok Voice 3.0
works.description: xAI's third speech-to-speech model, offered in the Voice Agent API at $0.08 per minute and used in Tesla cars, the Grok Bot voice mode and Starlink support lines. xAI cites Artificial Analysis results of 13 October 2026 that rank it first on the Speech-to-Speech Index (86.9, ahead of GPT-Live-1 and Gemini 3.8 Live) and at 97% on Full Duplex Bench.
works.description_zh: xAI 的第三代语音到语音模型，在 Voice Agent API 中按每分钟 0.08 美元提供，已用于特斯拉汽车、Grok Bot 的语音模式和 Starlink 客服热线。xAI 引用 Artificial Analysis 2026 年 10 月 13 日的结果：它在 Speech-to-Speech Index 上排名第一（86.9 分，高于 GPT-Live-1 与 Gemini 3.8 Live），在 Full Duplex Bench 上得分 97%。
works.idea_en: Voice-agent rankings now combine reasoning, task success and turn-taking, and the current leader is tuned for resolving support calls rather than for companionship.
works.idea_zh: 语音智能体的排名如今同时考察推理、任务完成与轮流发言，而目前的领先者是为解决客服来电而调校的，并非陪伴型产品。
works.method: Native speech-to-speech model (architecture unpublished); grok-voice-latest switched to it automatically. There is no published evidence that it backchannels while the user speaks, so it is listed as turn-based.
works.method_zh: 原生语音到语音模型（架构未公开）；grok-voice-latest 已自动切换到该模型。目前没有公开证据表明它会在用户说话时发出附和，因此按回合制归类。
works.specs: $0.08/min · <1 s latency (developer claim) · AA Speech-to-Speech Index 86.9

works.title: Drama 3
works.description: An open-weight text-to-speech model for multi-character scenes: one script can carry up to 16 tagged speakers, each cloned from a short reference clip, with inline cues such as [sighs] or [laughs]. Fish Audio released the weights on Hugging Face under its research licence on 13 October 2026, and Artificial Analysis listed the preview as the top open-weights TTS model.
works.description_zh: 一个面向多角色场景的开源权重语音合成模型：一段脚本最多可包含 16 个带标签的说话人，每个声音都可以用一小段参考音频克隆，并支持 [sighs]、[laughs] 这类行内提示。Fish Audio 于 2026 年 10 月 13 日在 Hugging Face 以其研究许可发布权重，Artificial Analysis 将其预览版列为开源权重语音合成模型第一名。
works.idea_en: A whole multi-voice scene can be generated and versioned on a lab's own GPU instead of being rented line by line from a closed voice API.
works.idea_zh: 整场多声音的戏可以在实验室自己的 GPU 上生成并固定版本，而不必逐句租用封闭的语音 API。
works.method: Mixture-of-experts text backbone (35B parameters, 3B active per token) with hybrid full and linear attention and a causal multi-codebook audio decoder (10 codebooks); served with SGLang-Omni and vLLM-Omni.
works.method_zh: 混合专家文本主干（350 亿参数，每个词元激活 30 亿），结合全注意力与线性注意力，配合因果多码本音频解码器（10 个码本）；可用 SGLang-Omni 与 vLLM-Omni 部署。
works.specs: 35B MoE (3B active) · up to 16 speakers · 83 languages (developer claim)

works.title: Mirelo SFX 2.0
works.description: A video-to-sound model that replaces a clip's audio without regenerating the picture: it keeps the dialogue, removes unwanted music and generates sound effects, foley and ambience synced to the action and consistent across cuts, for videos up to 10 minutes. Released on 14 October 2026 in Mirelo's studio and API and on platforms such as fal and Runway.
works.description_zh: 一个视频生成音效模型，无需重新生成画面就能替换片段的声音：它保留对白，去掉不需要的音乐，生成与动作同步、跨镜头保持一致的音效、拟音和环境声，单个视频最长 10 分钟。2026 年 10 月 14 日在 Mirelo 的工作室和 API 上线，也可在 fal、Runway 等平台使用。
works.idea_en: Separates the sound layer from generated video again, so a study can hold the picture fixed and vary only what is heard.
works.idea_zh: 把声音层重新从生成视频中分离出来，研究者可以固定画面，只改变听到的内容。
works.method: Video-conditioned audio generation with dialogue detection and preservation and removal of non-dialogue audio (architecture unpublished); Mirelo reports blind listening tests against other video-to-sound models and the native audio of video models.
works.method_zh: 以视频为条件的音频生成，包含对白检测与保留、非对白音频去除（架构未公开）；Mirelo 报告了与其他视频生成音效模型及视频模型原生音频的盲听比较。
works.specs: up to 10 min per pass (Studio and API)

works.title: Instant Soundtracks
works.description: An ElevenLabs feature that scores an uploaded video with original music and places generated sound effects at the moments the model detects, such as a whoosh on a logo reveal; effects stay on separate layers that can be moved or swapped. It can take the video's existing audio as a reference for genre, tempo and instrumentation, and has been available in ElevenCreative, ElevenMusic and the API since 15 October 2026.
works.description_zh: ElevenLabs 的一项功能：为上传的视频配上原创音乐，并在模型识别出的时刻放置生成的音效，例如标志出现时的“嗖”声；音效保留在独立的图层上，可以移动或替换。它还能把视频原有的音频作为曲风、速度与配器的参考，自 2026 年 10 月 15 日起在 ElevenCreative、ElevenMusic 和 API 中提供。
works.idea_en: Music and effects come back as separate, timed layers rather than one baked track, which keeps them editable per condition.
works.idea_zh: 音乐与音效以分开且带时间点的图层返回，而不是一条合成好的音轨，因此可以按实验条件分别修改。
works.method: Video analysis for effect cues and mood changes drives ElevenLabs' music model (likely Music v2) and sound-effect generation, aligned to timestamps on an editor timeline.
works.method_zh: 通过视频分析找出音效时机与情绪变化，驱动 ElevenLabs 的音乐模型（很可能是 Music v2）和音效生成，并对齐到编辑器时间线上的时间点。

works.title: Suno v6
works.description: Suno's 2026 generation of music models, developed with Warner Music Group, BMG and Believe; Suno describes them as faster and more expressive with more creative control, and pairs them with screening of uploaded audio and lyrics for unauthorized use. On 1 October 2026 Suno added Speech (beta), which generates a spoken voice and its background music as one track.
works.description_zh: Suno 2026 年的新一代音乐模型，与华纳音乐、BMG 和 Believe 合作开发；Suno 称其更快、更有表现力、可控性更强，同时对上传的音频和歌词进行未授权使用筛查。2026 年 10 月 1 日，Suno 又推出 Speech（测试版），把人声朗读与背景音乐作为一条音轨同时生成。
works.idea_en: Training with label partners, rather than on scraped catalogues, becomes part of a frontier music model's pitch, which matters when generated music appears in published studies or exhibited work.
works.idea_zh: 与唱片公司合作训练、而非抓取曲库，成了前沿音乐模型的卖点之一；当生成音乐出现在发表的研究或展出的作品中时，这一点很重要。
works.method: Music generation models (architecture unpublished) developed with record labels and publishers, with upload screening against unauthorized material.
works.method_zh: 与唱片公司和版权方合作开发的音乐生成模型（架构未公开），并对上传内容做未授权素材筛查。

works.title: MiniMax Music 3.0
works.description: MiniMax's open-weight song model: from lyrics with section tags and a structured description (genre, BPM, key, vocals, arrangement) it generates a complete song of up to five minutes with vocals in one pass. Weights are on Hugging Face and GitHub, and the model is also served through the MiniMax API.
works.description_zh: MiniMax 的开源权重歌曲模型：根据带段落标签的歌词和结构化描述（曲风、BPM、调性、人声、编曲），一次生成最长五分钟、带人声的完整歌曲。权重已发布在 Hugging Face 和 GitHub，也可通过 MiniMax API 调用。
works.idea_en: Gives labs an open, version-pinnable model for full-length music with section-level control instead of a closed subscription app.
works.idea_zh: 为实验室提供一个开放、可固定版本、能按段落控制的完整歌曲生成模型，而不是封闭的订阅应用。
works.method: Hybrid language model: an 8B global LLM (initialised from Qwen3-8B) predicts the first of eight RVQ codebooks for long-range structure, a 0.6B local LLM predicts the rest, and a 2.4B flow-matching decoder with a Flow-VAE renders 32 kHz audio from their fused hidden states.
works.method_zh: 混合语言模型：80 亿参数的全局大模型（由 Qwen3-8B 初始化）预测八层 RVQ 中的第一层以把握长程结构，6 亿参数的局部模型预测其余各层，再由 24 亿参数的流匹配解码器结合 Flow-VAE，从两者融合的隐藏状态渲染 32 kHz 音频。
works.specs: 8B global + 0.6B local LM · 2.4B flow matching · up to 5 min · 32 kHz

works.title: Qwen3.5-Omni
works.description: Alibaba's 2026 omni-modal model that listens to speech, watches video and answers in speech, offered through Model Studio (qwen3.5-omni-plus) and Qwen Chat rather than as open weights. Qwen highlights semantic interruption, speech recognition in 74 languages, expressive speech in 29, and 'audio-visual vibe coding': building a website or game from a spoken description shown to the camera. Its successor Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash reached Model Studio on 2026-09-17, followed on 2026-09-21 by a realtime version with WebRTC access and multichannel audio.
works.description_zh: 阿里巴巴 2026 年的全模态模型，能听语音、看视频并用语音回答，通过 Model Studio（qwen3.5-omni-plus）和 Qwen Chat 提供，没有开放权重。Qwen 重点介绍了语义打断、74 种语言的语音识别、29 种语言的富表现力语音生成，以及“音视频氛围编程”：对着摄像头口头描述，就能生成一个网站或小游戏。其后续版本 Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash 于 2026-09-17 上线百炼，2026-09-21 又推出支持 WebRTC 接入和多声道音频的实时版本。
works.idea_en: The open Qwen-Omni line moved behind an API in 2026, so labs that built on Qwen3-Omni's weights must keep the older model or accept a hosted one.
works.idea_zh: 开放的 Qwen-Omni 系列在 2026 年转为仅通过 API 提供，基于 Qwen3-Omni 权重开展工作的实验室只能沿用旧模型，或接受托管服务。
works.method: Thinker-Talker architecture with hybrid-attention mixture-of-experts in both parts, trained on over 100 million hours of audio-visual data; ARIA aligns text and speech units to stabilise streaming speech.
works.method_zh: Thinker-Talker 架构，两部分都采用混合注意力的混合专家结构，训练数据包含超过一亿小时的音视频内容；ARIA 对齐文本与语音单元，使流式语音更稳定。
works.specs: 256k context · 10+ h audio input · 400 s of 720p video at 1 fps

works.title: WorldSonus
works.description: A streaming video-to-audio model meant to give interactive world models a soundtrack: it generates stereo sound in 100 ms chunks as frames arrive, follows camera motion and scene layout, and accepts new sound instructions mid-stream. The authors report a real-time factor of 0.41 and quality matching offline bidirectional models on open-domain video-to-audio benchmarks; weights are released for non-commercial use.
works.description_zh: 一个流式视频生成音频模型，目标是为交互式世界模型配上声音：随着画面帧到来，它以 100 毫秒为单位生成立体声，跟随镜头运动与场景布局，并能在生成过程中接受新的声音指令。作者报告其实时率为 0.41，在开放领域的视频生成音频基准上与离线双向模型质量相当；权重以非商用许可发布。
works.idea_en: Sound can be generated live beside a playable world model and redirected during play, instead of being added afterwards to a finished clip.
works.idea_zh: 声音可以和可玩的世界模型同步实时生成，并在体验过程中被改变方向，而不是事后为成片补配。
works.method: Causal autoregressive diffusion over audio chunks with chunk-indexed prompt scheduling from an audio-centric captioning pipeline, trained with stereo supervision curated from stereo and ambisonic recordings.
works.method_zh: 对音频片段做因果自回归扩散，用面向音频的字幕流程生成按片段编号调度的提示，并以从立体声与全景声录音中整理出的立体声数据进行监督训练。
works.specs: stereo · 100 ms chunks · RTF 0.41 · CC BY-NC 4.0 weights

works.title: Audible World Models
works.description: A training-free pipeline that gives text-generated 3D worlds sound sources with fixed positions: it builds a panoramic 3D proxy of the world, finds sound-producing objects and ambient regions, synthesizes dry audio for each and renders what a listener hears as they move. Across 80 generated scenes the authors (Georgia Tech and Dolby) report higher spatial consistency than text-, video- and panorama-conditioned baselines; NeurIPS 2026.
works.description_zh: 一个无需训练的流程，为文本生成的三维世界配上位置固定的声源：先构建世界的全景三维代理，找出发声物体与环境声区域，为每一项合成干声，再按听者的移动渲染其听到的声音。在 80 个生成场景上，作者（佐治亚理工学院与杜比）报告其空间一致性高于以文本、视频和全景图为条件的基线；论文发表于 NeurIPS 2026。
works.idea_en: Puts sound into the world state rather than into a rendered video, so a source stays where it is when the visitor walks around it.
works.idea_zh: 把声音放进世界状态而不是渲染出的视频里，访客绕着声源走动时，声源仍待在原处。
works.method: Panorama-to-3D proxy with semantic layer separation, per-label dry audio synthesis, sources anchored to reconstructed geometry, and listener-dependent rendering by geometric acoustic propagation.
works.method_zh: 全景图转三维代理并做语义分层，按标签合成干声，把声源锚定到重建的几何上，再用几何声学传播做随听者位置变化的渲染。

paper.title: Audible World Models: Spatially Aware Sound Generation for 3D Worlds

works.title: OmniDream
works.description: Turns a silent, narrow field-of-view video into a 360° audiovisual scene: alongside a panoramic expansion of the picture, each visible sound source gets its own generated audio, which is propagated through a simulated scene and rendered as spatial audio that stays aligned as the viewer looks around. The University of Pennsylvania authors report better audio-visual alignment, spatial correctness and rated immersion than baselines.
works.description_zh: 把一段无声、视野狭窄的视频变成 360° 视听场景：在把画面扩展为全景的同时，为每个可见声源单独生成声音，经模拟场景传播后渲染成空间音频，观众转头环顾时声音始终与画面对齐。宾夕法尼亚大学的作者报告，其音画对齐、空间正确性与主观沉浸感均优于基线。
works.idea_en: Any ordinary clip can become a looked-around scene that also sounds right in every direction, without recording spatial audio.
works.idea_zh: 任意一段普通视频都能变成可以环顾、且各个方向听起来都对的场景，无需录制空间音频。
works.method: Training-free: an object-centric audio representation separates each source's intrinsic sound from scene-dependent acoustics, so sources are generated independently, propagation is simulated physically, and the result is rendered as first-order ambisonics.
works.method_zh: 无需训练：以物体为中心的音频表示把每个声源的本征声音与场景相关的声学效果分开，从而分别生成声源、用物理方法模拟传播，并渲染为一阶全景声。

paper.title: Enabling Immersive Audio-Visual Experience from Any Video

works.title: StereoBind
works.description: Extends joint video-audio generation to stereo, so that a generated sound moves left or right with its source on screen, a property the authors call dynamic spatial correspondence. The Xidian University and vivo team also built StereoWorld-29K, a stereo audio-video dataset with motion tracks, and StereoWorldBench for measuring audio-visual spatial consistency.
works.description_zh: 把音视频联合生成扩展到立体声，让生成的声音随画面中的声源左右移动，作者称之为“动态空间对应”。西安电子科技大学与 vivo 团队还构建了带运动轨迹的立体声音视频数据集 StereoWorld-29K，以及衡量音画空间一致性的 StereoWorldBench。
works.idea_en: Native audio in generated video starts to carry direction, a cue headsets need and mono soundtracks lack.
works.idea_zh: 生成视频的原生音频开始带有方向感，这正是头显所需、而单声道配乐缺少的线索。
works.method: Motion tracks condition a joint video-audio generator through visual motion binding, a spatial track encoder for absolute source position and a residual track RoPE for relative motion.
works.method_zh: 用运动轨迹为音视频联合生成器提供条件：视觉运动绑定建立声源对应，空间轨迹编码器表示声源的绝对位置，残差轨迹 RoPE 刻画相对运动。

paper.title: Hear the World in Stereo: Learning Dynamic Spatial Correspondence for Immersive Joint Video-Audio Generation

works.title: ThinkSound
works.description: An open video-to-audio model that reasons before it adds sound: it first generates a coherent foley track for a silent clip, then lets a user click an object to refine its sound, then edits the result from a written instruction, with a multimodal LLM writing a chain of thought at each stage. Released with the AudioCoT dataset by Alibaba's Tongyi speech team; NeurIPS 2025.
works.description_zh: 一个开源的视频生成音频模型，先推理再配声：先为无声片段生成连贯的拟音，再让用户点选某个物体细化它的声音，最后根据文字指令编辑结果；每个阶段都由多模态大模型写出思维链来引导。由阿里通义语音团队连同 AudioCoT 数据集一起发布，论文发表于 NeurIPS 2025。
works.idea_en: Sound design becomes an inspectable sequence of reasoned steps that a person can steer object by object.
works.idea_zh: 声音设计变成一串可以检查的推理步骤，人可以逐个物体地加以引导。
works.method: A multimodal LLM produces chain-of-thought descriptions of visual dynamics and acoustics that condition a unified flow-matching audio foundation model across generation, object-centric refinement and instruction-based editing.
works.method_zh: 多模态大模型生成关于画面动态与声学环境的思维链描述，用来驱动统一的流匹配音频基础模型，覆盖生成、以物体为中心的细化和基于指令的编辑三个阶段。

paper.title: ThinkSound: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models for Audio Generation and Editing

works.title: Kling-Foley
works.description: Kuaishou's video-to-audio model from the Kling team: from a video and an optional text prompt it generates synchronized stereo sound effects and background music of any length, matched to the clip. Kuaishou released the industrial benchmark Kling-Audio-Eval with it, but not the model weights.
works.description_zh: 快手可灵团队的视频生成音频模型：根据视频和可选的文字提示，生成与画面同步、任意时长的立体声音效与背景音乐。快手随之开源了工业级评测基准 Kling-Audio-Eval，但没有公开模型权重。
works.idea_en: Shows how a frontier video lab builds sound as a separate, length-adaptive stage before folding audio into the video model itself.
works.idea_zh: 展示了前沿视频团队如何先把声音做成独立、可适应时长的环节，再把音频并入视频模型本身。
works.method: Multimodal flow-matching MMDiT conditioned jointly on text, video and frame-level features predicts VAE latents, decoded to a mono mel-spectrogram, converted to stereo by a Mono2Stereo module and vocoded.
works.method_zh: 以文本、视频和逐帧特征联合为条件的多模态流匹配 MMDiT 预测 VAE 隐变量，解码为单声道梅尔谱，经 Mono2Stereo 模块转为立体声后再由声码器合成波形。

paper.title: Kling-Foley: Multimodal Diffusion Transformer for High-Quality Video-to-Audio Generation

works.title: Passing
works.description: A video installation that turns one continuous monorail-window recording into an endless, shifting journey by resampling it as a space-time volume; a camera detects whether someone stands in front of the screen and steers the transitions. The video stream is sonified live by Sony's real-time video-to-audio model SpecMaskFoley, which proposes sound for a landscape that no longer follows ordinary space and time.
works.description_zh: 一件影像装置：把一段连续拍摄的单轨列车车窗影像当作时空体重新采样，变成一段没有尽头、不断变化的旅程；摄像头检测屏幕前是否有人，并据此引导画面转换。影像流由索尼的实时视频生成音频模型 SpecMaskFoley 现场配声，为一个不再遵循常规时空的风景“设想”出可能的声音。
works.idea_en: Uses a video-to-audio model as a live listener to images it was never trained on, and lets audience presence steer what it hears.
works.idea_zh: 把视频生成音频模型当作一位实时“聆听者”，面对它从未见过的画面，并让观众的在场引导它听到什么。
works.method: Frames stacked into a spatiotemporal volume and sliced along nonlinear trajectories; camera-based presence detection selects sequences; real-time SpecMaskFoley generates the synchronized soundscape.
works.method_zh: 把帧堆叠成时空体并沿非线性轨迹切片；基于摄像头的在场检测选择片段；实时 SpecMaskFoley 生成同步声景。

paper.title: Passing: An Endless Journey through Reconstructed Spacetime with AI-Generated Sound

works.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS
works.description: Google's text-to-speech models, generally available in the Gemini API since 22 September 2026: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS for directed acting, regional dialects and two-speaker dialogue, and Flash-Lite TTS for high-volume use and real-time agent pipelines. A new Voices endpoint designs persistent voices from a text prompt and replicates a voice after consent verification; Hume's Real World VoiceEQ leaderboard ranked Flash TTS first two days later.
works.description_zh: 谷歌的语音合成模型，自 2026 年 9 月 22 日起在 Gemini API 中正式可用：Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS 面向有表演指导的演绎、地方口音和双人对话，Flash-Lite TTS 面向大批量生成和实时智能体流程。新的 Voices 接口可以根据文字提示设计可长期保存的声音，并在验证授权后复刻某个声音；两天后，Hume 的 Real World VoiceEQ 排行榜把 Flash TTS 排在第一位。
works.idea_en: Prompt-designed voices that persist across sessions make it cheap to cast a stable set of characters, with consent checks built into cloning.
works.idea_zh: 可以跨会话保存的提示设计声音，让低成本地为一组角色稳定“选角”成为可能，克隆声音时还内置了授权核验。
works.method: Gemini-based speech generation (architecture unpublished) steered by natural-language direction; Flash-Lite replaces gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview (April 2026).
works.method_zh: 基于 Gemini 的语音生成（架构未公开），用自然语言指导发声；Flash-Lite 取代 2026 年 4 月的 gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview。
works.specs: 150+ prebuilt and custom voices · two-speaker dialogue

works.title: Gemini live speech translation
works.description: Continuous speech-to-speech translation from Gemini's native audio models: with headphones, the Google Translate app (beta from December 2025) renders what people around you say in your language while keeping the speaker's intonation, pacing and pitch, across more than 70 languages and 2,000 language pairs. Google now offers the model to developers as Gemini 3.5 Live Translate in AI Studio.
works.description_zh: Gemini 原生音频模型提供的连续语音到语音翻译：戴上耳机，Google 翻译应用（2025 年 12 月起测试）会把身边人说的话转成你的语言，同时保留说话人的语调、节奏和音高，覆盖 70 多种语言、2000 多个语言对。谷歌现在在 AI Studio 中以 Gemini 3.5 Live Translate 的名称向开发者提供该模型。
works.idea_en: Lets two people without a shared language stay in one spoken exchange, widening who can take part in a voice-driven scenario.
works.idea_zh: 让没有共同语言的两个人也能留在同一场口语交流中，扩大了能参与语音驱动情境的人群。
works.method: Streaming audio-to-audio translation on Gemini 2.5 Flash Native Audio (December 2025 update) with voice-style preservation and noise filtering; succeeded by Gemini 3.5 Live Translate.
works.method_zh: 基于 Gemini 2.5 Flash Native Audio（2025 年 12 月更新）的流式音频到音频翻译，保留说话风格并过滤噪声；后续由 Gemini 3.5 Live Translate 接替。

works.title: StepAudio 3 Realtime
works.description: StepFun's 2026 voice-conversation model, built on a listen-converse-think-act loop: it keeps talking through a listener's 'right' or 'mm-hm', yields to real interruptions, reasons privately while it speaks and runs tools in the background. StepFun reports first place on Artificial Analysis's Full Duplex Bench (98.9 overall); it is offered through the StepFun Realtime API and Voice Studio.
works.description_zh: 阶跃星辰 2026 年的语音对话模型，围绕“听—说—想—做”的循环构建：听者说“对”“嗯”时它会继续讲，真正被打断时让出话轮，边说边在后台私下推理，并在后台调用工具。阶跃星辰报告其在 Artificial Analysis 的 Full Duplex Bench 上排名第一（总分 98.9）；通过阶跃 Realtime API 和 Voice Studio 提供。
works.idea_en: Floor management learned from both audio streams lets a voice character tell an acknowledgement from a correction, though the report does not show it backchanneling itself.
works.idea_zh: 从双方两路音频中学到的话轮管理，让语音角色能分辨对方是在附和还是在纠正；不过报告没有展示它自己发出附和。
works.method: Mixture-of-experts audio-language model (about 196B total, 11B active parameters) on a Step 3.7 Flash backbone with a Qwen3-Omni AuT audio encoder, user and model audio as two synchronized streams, and think-while-speaking. The report describes handling user backchannels but not producing them, so it is listed as turn-based.
works.method_zh: 混合专家音频语言模型（总参数约 1960 亿、激活 110 亿），以 Step 3.7 Flash 为主干，采用 Qwen3-Omni 的 AuT 音频编码器，用户与模型音频作为两路同步流，并支持边说边想。报告描述了如何处理用户的附和，但没有描述模型自己发出附和，因此按回合制归类。
works.specs: ~196B MoE (11B active) · AA Full Duplex Bench 98.9 (developer-reported)

works.title: StepAudio 3 Gen
works.description: A general audio model that produces a whole sound scene from one description: several characters with designed voices, emotions and dialects talking to each other, plus sound effects, ambience, background music and singing, placed in a specified order on one timeline. StepFun released it on 11 September 2026 as a free preview in its API (stepaudio-3-gen-preview), alongside StepAudio 3 TTS and Music.
works.description_zh: 一个通用音频模型，能根据一段描述生成完整的声音场景：多个角色以设计好的音色、情绪和方言彼此对话，再加上音效、环境声、背景音乐和演唱，并按指定顺序排在同一条时间线上。阶跃星辰于 2026 年 9 月 11 日以免费预览形式在 API 中发布（stepaudio-3-gen-preview），同时推出 StepAudio 3 TTS 与 Music。
works.idea_en: Moves from generating a voice line to generating an audio situation: who speaks, what happens around them and the music, specified together in words.
works.idea_zh: 从生成一句台词走向生成一个声音情境：谁在说话、周围发生了什么、配什么音乐，都用文字一并设定。
works.method: Discrete autoregressive generator over a shared 12.5 Hz RVQ code space (16 × 2048) for speech, sound and music: the backbone predicts the first codebook over time and a light causal Transformer completes the other fifteen, with interference-aware progressive pretraining to keep the LLM's text abilities.
works.method_zh: 在语音、音效与音乐共享的 12.5 Hz RVQ 码空间（16 × 2048）上做离散自回归生成：主干沿时间预测第一层码本，轻量因果 Transformer 补全其余十五层；采用考虑干扰的渐进式预训练，以保留大模型的文本能力。

works.title: Seed Speech 2.0
works.description: ByteDance's 2026 speech stack on BytePlus, pairing TTS 2.0 with ASR 2.0. TTS 2.0 reads the user's query together with the reply it is voicing, so tone, rhythm and pauses fit the exchange, and prompts or reference context set emotion, rate, pitch, timbre and style; BytePlus reports about 90% accuracy when reading mathematical and scientific formulas aloud.
works.description_zh: 字节跳动 2026 年在 BytePlus 上推出的语音技术组合，包含 TTS 2.0 与 ASR 2.0。TTS 2.0 会把用户的问题和它要说出的回答一起理解，使语气、节奏和停顿契合这次交流；提示词或参考上下文可以设定情绪、语速、音高、音色和风格。BytePlus 报告其朗读数学与科学公式的准确率约为 90%。
works.idea_en: Like Inworld's TTS-2, it makes a reply's delivery depend on what was just said, a cue that scripted voice pipelines otherwise lack.
works.idea_zh: 与 Inworld 的 TTS-2 类似，它让回答的语气取决于对方刚刚说了什么，这是脚本化语音流程原本缺少的线索。
works.method: Query-response speech synthesis conditioned on both the conversational query and the response text, with prompt and reference-context control (architecture unpublished).
works.method_zh: 以对话中的提问和回答文本共同为条件的“问—答”式语音合成，并支持提示词与参考上下文控制（架构未公开）。

works.title: Gradium
works.description: A voice-AI company founded in 2025 by Kyutai's Moshi researchers (Neil Zeghidour, Alexandre Défossez, Laurent Mazaré, Olivier Teboul) that sells streaming text-to-speech, speech-to-text, live translation, voice cloning, prompt-based voice design and on-device TTS for voice agents. It launched in December 2025 with a $70M seed, extended to $100M in July 2026, and reports sub-50 ms TTS latency and a catalogue of 1,400 voices (October 2026).
works.description_zh: 一家 2025 年由 Kyutai 的 Moshi 研究者（Neil Zeghidour、Alexandre Défossez、Laurent Mazaré、Olivier Teboul）创立的语音 AI 公司，为语音智能体提供流式语音合成、语音识别、实时翻译、声音克隆、提示式声音设计和端侧语音合成。2025 年 12 月以 7000 万美元种子轮亮相，2026 年 7 月扩展到 1 亿美元，并报告语音合成延迟低于 50 毫秒、声音库达 1400 个（2026 年 10 月）。
works.idea_en: The team behind the first open full-duplex model now sells fast cascade components, which suggests where production voice agents stood in 2026.
works.idea_zh: 做出第一个开源全双工模型的团队，如今出售的是快速的级联组件，这说明了 2026 年生产环境中语音智能体所处的位置。
works.method: Streaming TTS and STT models (likely descended from Kyutai's delayed-streams work) plus prompt-based voice design, which Gradium reports native speakers preferred over five competitors in 72.6% of blind pairwise comparisons.
works.method_zh: 流式语音合成与语音识别模型（很可能源自 Kyutai 的延迟流建模工作），以及提示式声音设计；Gradium 报告在盲听两两比较中，母语者有 72.6% 的情况更偏好其声音而非五家竞品。
works.specs: sub-50 ms TTS latency (developer claim) · 1.4k voices · EN/FR/ES/DE/PT

leads.name: Lyria 3.5 (Google DeepMind)
leads.why: Point release (GA 2026-09-03) already folded into the Lyria 3 work's description and specs.

leads.name: Hume EVI 4 / Octave 2
leads.why: EVI 4-mini and Octave 2 (2025-10-03, Hume changelog) are point releases of EVI 3 and Octave; Hume sunsets both APIs on 2026-11-13, recorded as status edits.

leads.name: Kyutai Invincible Voice
leads.why: Assistive dialogue-suggestion tool for people living with ALS (2026-02-24); communication aid, not generation of immersive situations.

leads.name: GPT-Live 1 (OpenAI full-duplex voice model)
leads.why: Already the work openai--gpt-live (API GA 2026-09-10 recorded there).

leads.name: Gemini 3.8 Live / Live Extended Thinking
leads.why: Already the work google-deepmind--gemini-3-8-live (GA 2026-09-15).

leads.name: Inworld speech-to-speech API
leads.why: Folded into inworld-ai--realtime-tts-2: a cascaded STT + LLM + TTS-2 session marketed as full-duplex but turn-based with barge-in.

leads.name: PhysWave (Yao et al., EMNLP 2026)
leads.why: Physics-guided latent diffusion for text-to-FOA spatial audio with trajectory control and a 300K-clip FOA dataset (arXiv 2608.29549); project page has audio samples and a figure, no video.

leads.name: YT-SPEECH: visually guided FOA speech spatialization (Luo et al., Interspeech 2026)
leads.why: Recovers first-order ambisonics for speech scenes from 360° video plus an omni track (arXiv 2608.24579); no project page or video.

leads.name: MAI-Voice-2 / MAI-Voice-2.1 (Microsoft AI)
leads.why: First-party TTS in 15 languages (2026-06-02) and 2.1 + Flash (2026-10-01) in Microsoft Foundry; no official demo video found.

leads.name: Sesame TurnBench
leads.why: Open turn-taking benchmark: 30 h of triple-annotated dyadic speech, scoring grounded in conversation analysis, 14 systems (2026-08-28); belongs to infra/benchmarks.

leads.name: Qwen-Audio-3.1 / TTS-Next (Alibaba)
leads.why: Upgraded ASR, TTS and realtime models plus TTS-Next for audio creation (2026-09-23, Qwen post with images); check for a model page and video.

leads.name: Kyutai RL post-training for full-duplex speech
leads.why: Blog post (2026-06-10) on post-training full-duplex spoken dialogue models with RL for interactivity; check for released weights or demo.

leads.name: Hume Real World VoiceEQ leaderboards
leads.why: Hume's 2026 pivot from voice models to evaluation (VoiceEQ, controllability and replication leaderboards, July-Sept 2026); belongs to infra/benchmarks.

leads.name: CharDuplex (Wu et al., 2026)
leads.why: Character-consistent full-duplex spoken dialogue model adapted from GLM-4-Voice, with persona-conditioned SFT and RL against an LLM-simulated user (FDGym) (arXiv 2609.34461); check for demo media.

leads.name: D2: full-duplex models from half-duplex backbones (Chang et al., 2026)
leads.why: Converts Qwen3-Omni and LLaMA-Omni 2 into full-duplex models at 12.5 Hz (99.2% turn-taking success, 521 ms latency) (arXiv 2610.17124); has a demo page.

leads.name: Realtime-Venus (Ant Group, 2026)
leads.why: Proactive full-duplex audio-visual and audio-only 9B models with asynchronous delegation to a background harness (arXiv 2609.13814); check access, backchanneling and media.

leads.name: Bin2Ambi (Milner et al., 2026)
leads.why: Reconstructs ambisonic sound fields from head-tracked binaural audio (arXiv 2609.39732); conversion rather than generation, check for media.

leads.name: ELLSA 2: full-duplex interaction with speech, expressions and gestures (Wang et al., 2026)
leads.why: End-to-end full-duplex dialogue model that also streams gestures and facial expressions while silent (arXiv 2610.21452); belongs to avatars/nonverbal. Added in avatars-2026-10 as siyin-wang--ellsa-2.

leads.name: Kandinsky 6.0 Video (open text-to-audio-video)
leads.why: Open-source foundation models for synchronized video and audio generation (arXiv 2610.05608, 2026-10-04); belongs to video. Covered by work kandinsky-lab--kandinsky-6-video (2026-10 update).

leads.name: Real-time joint audio-video generation by parallel adapter composition (2026)
leads.why: Real-time joint audio-video generation (arXiv 2610.10343, 2026-10-08); belongs to video/realtime.
